description: Sam, a backend/platform engineer at a startup. Terse, technical, late-night worker.
turns: Hey, I'm Sam. I work as a backend engineer.
Mostly I write Rust these days, though I started out in Python.
I'm at a startup called Nimbus - we build data infrastructure.
ugh, another flaky CI run, third one today
Please keep your answers short and technical, I don't need hand-holding.
I've got a dog, a border collie named Biscuit.
Actually, correction - I switched teams last month. I'm on the platform team now, not backend.
I usually work late; I'm most productive after 10pm.
I use Neovim, by the way, not VSCode.
My partner Alex and I are planning a trip to Japan in the spring.
Coffee is life. Flat white, no sugar.
Like I said, I mostly write Rust now.
I'm allergic to shellfish - worth knowing if we ever talk food.
I'm really into mechanical keyboards; currently on a tactile-switch build.
